facts.fact: The Standards Act (Act 16 of 1995, commenced 1 August 1996) establishes the Botswana Bureau of Standards as a body corporate and a Standards Council, and charges the Bureau with preparing and publishing Botswana Standards; it names no information technology or data standard.

note: Statute is not IT-specific; its standards marks licensing and recognition of inspection agencies for product and quality system certification are general quality infrastructure, so no certification fact is recorded.
